_comment: Model profiles for model-vs-model evals. Each profile is a set of env-var overrides applied (via os.environ) BEFORE the upsell_ranker agents are imported, so LiteLlm() at module-import picks up the right model_id per role. There is no native ADK compare mode: model-vs-model is done by running the SAME golden eval set once per profile and diffing the results (see eval_compare.py). Role env vars match agent.py: UPSELL_AGENT_MODEL, DWH_ANALYST_MODEL, SIGNAL_AGENT_MODEL, SIGNAL_REVIEWER_MODEL. All values are LiteLLM model strings.
